title: Notification channels
question: Who hears about it when a workload stops being provable?
intro: RestoreLab speaks only when a verdict or a proof level moves. A quiet channel is a channel with nothing to report, which is why a channel that has silently broken is worth finding before it matters.
readOnly: This session can read the channels but not change them.

empty.title: No channel yet
empty.description: Nothing is told when a drill changes what it proves. Add a channel here, or from a terminal.

unavailable.title: This server has no configuration to write back to
unavailable.description: Channels live in config.yaml, and this RestoreLab was started without a file it can write. Nothing on this screen would survive a restart.

enabled.offHint: This channel is configured and receives nothing.

health.neverHint: This channel has never carried a message. Send it a test.

test.hint: Sends one sample message now, so this path has been seen working before it is needed.

form.idHint: How this channel is named in the logs, in doctor and on this screen.
form.idFixed: A channel cannot be renamed. Remove it and add another.
form.urlNewHint: Sealed with the master key before it reaches disk, and never shown again.
form.urlKept: Leave blank and it keeps the stored URL
form.urlKeptHint: RestoreLab never hands a webhook URL back, so this field starts empty. Leaving it empty changes nothing; typing one replaces it.

delete.title: Remove {{id}}?
delete.description: This channel stops receiving anything, and nothing will say so afterwards.
delete.keeps: Messages already delivered keep their record, and no other channel is affected.
